title: Data Quality Issues in Multilingual Speech Datasets: The Need for Sociolinguistic Awareness and Proactive Language Planning

bias_targets.target: Sociolinguistic Bias (Language, Dialect, and Orthography Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Classifying dataset text prompts using rule-based and linguistic filter scripts to identify dialectal, register, or orthographic mismatches (e.g., Norwegian Bokmål vs. Nynorsk, Arabic MSA vs. Dialect, Standard Written Chinese vs. Cantonese) and measuring the resulting Word Error Rate (WER) degradation in ASR models.

Analyzing dataset metadata to calculate the number of unique speakers and the average recording hours per speaker across language subsets to quantify data concentration and the risk of overfitting to specific ages, genders, or accents.

Qualitative evaluation by native speaker volunteers who reviewed sampled sentences to assess whether the text and audio represent everyday, natural conversations versus formal, literary, or encyclopedic domains.
